title: clarity
content_html:
clarity

Through a glass clearly and fog raise a question about what becomes legible when detail is softened. Optical sharpness, the coherence of a composition and the ease of following an idea can come apart. Defocus might make a relation clearer by making the things it connects less distinct. The Library’s discussion of coherence and decoherence gives those words a precise use in physics. What do they suggest by analogy about the way an image holds together or comes apart? Through a glass clearly · Decoherence, interference and quantum computation

Reading note. Daoism. Chapter 15 of the Daodejing asks how muddy water becomes clear as it settles. In an image, clarity might likewise come from waiting or giving the eye less to do. What comes into view when we let the image settle, and what comes into view when we actively bring a detail into focus? Daodejing, 15
